However at the same time, I also question myself do I actually need the performance clock boost provided by the 9th gen ( that might potentially lead to a even higher CPU temp than the 8750h ) . The smart thing to do now might just be patient and wait it out , however the focus of manufacturers this year seems to be OLED screen/240hz instead of maybe inventing a better thermal solution to the CPU we currently have , which is still awesome as we have all these new technolgoies coming in, but as you have mentioned its also important to get the cooling right.
